cat > /usr/local/bin/setup-git-server.sh <<'EOS'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# ---- git user ----
id git >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash git
echo 'git:password' | chpasswd
# ensure account not locked
passwd -u git >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

# ---- web roots ----
mkdir -p /var/www/main /var/www/dev
chown -R git:git /var/www/main /var/www/dev
chmod -R 755 /var/www

# ---- bare repo ----
mkdir -p /git
git init --bare --initial-branch=main /git/project >/dev/null
chown -R git:git /git
chmod -R g+rwX /git/project

# ---- post-receive hook ----
cat > /git/project/hooks/post-receive <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
GIT_DIR=/git/project
export GIT_DIR
while read -r oldrev newrev ref; do
  branch="${ref#refs/heads/}"
  case "$branch" in
    main)
      mkdir -p /var/www/main
      git --git-dir="$GIT_DIR" --work-tree=/var/www/main checkout -f main >/dev/null 2>&1
      echo "Deployed main -> /var/www/main"
      ;;
    dev)
      mkdir -p /var/www/dev
      git --git-dir="$GIT_DIR" --work-tree=/var/www/dev checkout -f dev >/dev/null 2>&1
      echo "Deployed dev -> /var/www/dev"
      ;;
  esac
done
chmod -R a+rX /var/www/main /var/www/dev 2>/dev/null || true
EOF
chmod +x /git/project/hooks/post-receive
chown git:git /git/project/hooks/post-receive

# ---- ssh server ----
mkdir -p /run/sshd /var/run/sshd
cat > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/00-git.conf <<'EOF'
Port 22
PasswordAuthentication yes
PermitRootLogin yes
PubkeyAuthentication yes
UsePAM yes
KbdInteractiveAuthentication yes
PermitUserEnvironment no
AcceptEnv LANG LC_*
EOF
ssh-keygen -A >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
# relaxed client config so automated clones don't stall on host key prompts
cat > /etc/ssh/ssh_config.d/00-local.conf <<'EOF'
Host localhost 127.0.0.1
    StrictHostKeyChecking no
    UserKnownHostsFile /dev/null
    LogLevel ERROR
EOF

# ---- TLS cert ----
mkdir -p /etc/nginx/ssl
if [ ! -f /etc/nginx/ssl/server.crt ]; then
  openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -days 3650 \
    -keyout /etc/nginx/ssl/server.key -out /etc/nginx/ssl/server.crt \
    -subj "/CN=localhost" -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1" >/dev/null 2>&1
  chmod 600 /etc/nginx/ssl/server.key
fi

# ---- nginx ----
rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default
cat > /etc/nginx/sites-available/git-deploy <<'EOF'
server {
    listen 8443 ssl;
    listen [::]:8443 ssl;
    server_name localhost;

    ssl_certificate     /etc/nginx/ssl/server.crt;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/ssl/server.key;

    root /var/www/main;
    index index.html;

    location /dev/ {
        alias /var/www/dev/;
        index index.html;
        try_files $uri $uri/ /dev/index.html;
    }

    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ =404;
    }
}
EOF
ln -sf /etc/nginx/sites-available/git-deploy /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/git-deploy
nginx -t

# ---- start services ----
pkill -x sshd >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
/usr/sbin/sshd
nginx -s reload >/dev/null 2>&1 || nginx
echo "setup complete"
EOS
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/setup-git-server.sh
rm -rf /git
/usr/local/bin/setup-git-server.sh
